title: Launch Handshake Accelerator: end-to-end catalog onboarding checklist for new model additions
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Purpose: Provide a prescriptive, stakeholder-driven 'handshake' checklist that accelerates new model additions into the public catalog with coordinated benchmarks, docs, release notes, and announcement assets. This artifact standardizes preflight gates, primary owners, and communication touchpoints so product, engineering, design, and go-to-market teams can run a predictable, low-risk launch.
acceptance_criteria: Model entry in catalog with canonical name, tags, and bills of material
Benchmarks uploaded and validated against reference harness with performance metrics and validity flags
Docs: API examples, migration notes, and 'cost/latency' guidance published in developer docs
Release notes drafted, reviewed by stakeholders, and staged for publishing
Launch announcement draft approved by comms and scheduled in product calendar
Rollout plan with canary thresholds and fallback variants configured in Console
milestones: Docs and quickstarts published to docs site - 2026-03-26
Catalog entry live and telemetry monitored - 2026-04-10
stakeholders: Design: Priya Rao (docs and UI screenshots)
deliverables: Catalog metadata JSON (model name, family, tags, recommended profiles)
Benchmark report (latency P50/P95, throughput, mem, quantized variants)
Docs: Quickstart, API snippet, structured output example, migration notes
Release notes entry (what's new, breaking changes, known limitations)
Launch assets: blog draft, social copy, screenshots, SLAs / pricing notes
Console config: rollout strategy, canary weights, fallback variants
pre_launch_tasks: Verify license compliance and red-team the model for safety issues
Run standardized eval suite and flag regressions against baseline
Generate size/quantization matrix and recommended instance types
Create example SDK calls and sample prompts for docs team
Populate catalog metadata template and tag for use-cases
Schedule canary window and configure monitoring alerts in Console
post_launch_tasks: Monitor telemetry for quality regressions and unexpected error rates
Collect initial customer feedback and triage in weekly cadence
Run cost-per-token analysis and recommend batching/quantization knobs
Execute knowledge transfer to Support and update internal runbooks
Close loop on any outstanding security findings or license caveats
Publish post-launch learnings and update the onboarding checklist
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Benchmark regressions discovered late - Mitigation: block public listing until regression threshold cleared and require experimental tag if partial
Risk: Docs misrepresent performance - Mitigation: include explicit table of measured P50/P95 and test harness link
Risk: License or model governance issue - Mitigation: security sign-off required and escrow of model artifacts until cleared
Risk: Announcement causes spike exceeding capacity - Mitigation: preconfigure autoscale and have Dedicated fallback ready
communications: Weekly sync: Monday 09:30 PT (PM, Eng, Design, Research, DX)
Release notes draft shared in Google Drive -> shared review link (ask for comments within 48 hours)
Announcement plan: blog + product changelog + customer newsletter + support playbook
Stakeholder approvals: GTM and Legal must approve copy 5 business days before publish
